Abhishek Bachchan Wants to Recreate 'Kajra Re' Song

Actor Abhishek Bachchan expressed a desire to recreate the song 'Kajra Re', which featured his wife Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and his father Amitabh Bachchan. He mentioned that the original song was shot on his birthday and involved a four-hour dance sequence with Aishwarya Rai and his father.
